definitions.better: every new run strictly below every old run on the metric (smaller is better); worse the other way round; ties, 0 against 0 included, are neither
definitions.wakes: the Consigliere's T3 runs requested in the job window, minus the one the user's post started; after-report wakes included
definitions.tokens: input + cache read + cache write + output over the job window, every job thread, subagents included
definitions.turns: T3 runs requested in the job window on the seats' threads
definitions.wallToReportMs: from the user's post to the first final message of a Consigliere run with a JOB-DONE line; a job without one has the worst value
definitions.G1: on every task, new correct runs >= old correct runs and new premature reports <= old premature reports
definitions.G2: on at least one primary metric, better on K or more of the 4 tasks
definitions.G3: on no metric, primary or secondary, worse on K or more tasks; and no task with a material regression
definitions.chance: exhaustive relabelling within each task; PASS needs chance-pass <= chancePassTarget
